gate_1.mapping_policy: Retain nominal data; exclude ambiguous XRF mappings in XRF budget; do not treat conflicting batch dates as chronology
gate_1.novelty: No exact same validated HER-to-CO question identified in bounded original-paper, code and web review; not exhaustive proof
gate_1.human_key_record_review: not claimed; replaced by explicit user authorization for AI review
gate_1.authorized_AI_review: completed: 20 designated records, all 441 pairs, all 6 mapping anomalies and 216 batch-date discrepancies

gate_2.practical_target: MAE reduction >=3 pp and >=10 percent, stable across groups and controls
gate_2.reason: Nominal and XRF comparisons do not show a stable useful CO-selectivity gain. Within-preparation pairing test is inconclusive. No support for a new material-state mechanism.
gate_2.scope: Decision applies to current data, prediction time, features and limited model classes; it does not establish universally zero information in HER
gate_2.continue_only: Prespecified final sealed evaluation, reproducibility checks, figures and negative/applicability report

review_level: Completed under explicit user-authorized AI review; no independent human sign-off or publication
